company.name: CATHAY GP HLDGS / Cathay Media and Education Group Inc.

business_overview.one_sentence: The group operates PRC higher and vocational education, TV/film production and investment, and livestreaming e-commerce and artist management businesses.

segments.name: Higher and vocational education
segments.source: Annual Report 2023, note 5 segment information, p.98; business review p.5-p.6

segments.name: Entertainment and livestreaming e-commerce
segments.source: Annual Report 2023, note 5 segment information, p.98

business_overview.revenue_model: Tuition and boarding fees are generally received in advance and recognized over time; livestreaming includes commission and fixed promotion fees; TV/film products are recognized on delivery.
business_notes: As at 31 December 2023 the group had approximately 29,276 students.
The group uses contractual arrangements for PRC consolidated affiliated entities, including CUCN and other onshore holdcos.
2023 loss was mainly driven by impairment losses on TV/film receivables and Olympic College bridging loans.

non_recurring_items.item: Impairment losses under expected credit loss model, net
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Mainly TV/film trade receivable impairment and Olympic College bridging loan impairment

non_recurring_items.item: Impairment loss on prepayment for television series production
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Write-down related to Galloped Era II TV/film project, included in cost of revenue

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Operating cash flow was positive in 2022-2023, but 2023 profit was dominated by non-cash impairments and the TV/film business had severe receivable impairment. 2023 total capex was RMB254.2 million, primarily for the university; a conservative owner-distributable cash base should be well below education segment profit.

evidence.source: HKEXnews title search and local PDF

evidence.value: Majority of assets and operations located in PRC; consolidated affiliated entities accounted for through contractual arrangements
evidence.source: Annual Report 2023, note 1 p.77 and definitions p.136-p.137

gaps: The annual report does not split cash and deposits by listed parent, offshore subsidiaries, PRC subsidiaries, school entities or VIE entities.
The annual report does not disclose a precise restricted portion of 2023 cash beyond noting 2022 frozen bank deposit had been released.
Maintenance versus growth capex is not separately disclosed; university capex was estimated conservatively for owner-earnback analysis.
Only 2022 and 2023 operating cash flow details are available in this annual report; 2021 cash flow was not extracted from a separate annual report.
